eyebrow: The exact reverse of FOR JSON
code:
-- Rows INTO JSON:
SELECT TOP 2 ProductID, Name FROM Production.Product
FOR JSON PATH;

-- JSON BACK INTO rows:
SELECT ProductID, Name
FROM OPENJSON(@Json)
WITH (ProductID INT '$.ProductID', Name NVARCHAR(50) '$.Name');
caption: FOR JSON and OPENJSON undo each other.
